outcome.interpretation: After campaign evidence grew from 76 to 80 records, the same tight request returned no inspectable observation, pressure hypothesis, or improvement relation and exceeded its requested response byte limit.

pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Prefer the newest complete observation-to-pressure-to-improvement path, remove duplicated contextual fields from its compact form, and ensure the final serialized projection stays within the requested budget while retaining truthful omission counts and exact source pointers.
pressure_hypothesis.interpretation: Evidence-priority compaction fit the earlier 76-record response, but additional campaign context made the compact path exceed the limit; fallback omitted all evidence rows and still returned an oversized summary.
pressure_hypothesis.title: Campaign growth can erase linked ECI evidence under a tight response budget
